## The question

[Section headers in margins](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/1313/section-headers-in-margins), asked by [Amir Rachum](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/5/amir-rachum) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-08-07; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I'm working on my resume in LyX and I would like my section headers to look like [this][q-1]. What should I write in the preamble to achieve this?
>
>
>   [q-1]: http://rpi.edu/dept/arc/training/latex/resumes/res2.pdf
:::

Here is the [source](https://web.archive.org/web/20200222200455/http://rpi.edu/dept/arc/training/latex/resumes/res2.tex) of the document you linked to.  Just copy it and and change it.

You need the [`res`](https://web.archive.org/web/20200222200445/http://rpi.edu/dept/arc/training/latex/resumes/res.cls) class which is downloadable from the same place.
